confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are rough estimates from aggregator cost-of-living pages and one Numbeo-style listing, which mix undated snapshots and ringgit/USD conversions. Cappuccino (about RM12-14) and draft beer (about RM17) are the best-supported figures. Cocktail and wine are weaker: they rest on undated 50 Best and Lonely Planet listings with unclear currency, plus a beer-relative judgment. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the city context. No live booking pages or current listings were inspected. The FX observation is stale: the RBA page search result showed 0.7088 for 20 March 2026, not a November 2026 observation, and I could not confirm a later official RBA value.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Malaysian and Southeast Asian mid-sized tourist cities. Hawker and kopitiam prices anchor the inexpensive tier. Penang's cafe and bar prices are set against Kuala Lumpur-style urban pricing and tourist-area premiums in George Town. Accommodation is inferred from general knowledge of Penang guesthouse and hotel pricing, not from listings.
